synth.notes:
Block mode: A1/A2 move both blocks y-4/+4, A3 apart, A4 together (mirrored); each block moves alone if its target cell is in its half, in bounds, and not a maze, marker or other-block cell.
Clicking an inactive marker arms: blocks become color_1 players and that marker turns active (11). Armed A1-A4 move the active marker by 4. Clicking another marker switches; clicking a player returns to block mode; other clicks and A5 do nothing.
Timer bars: w=floor(3(a+1)/7), a = actions taken incl. no-ops. Tracked through continuity-gated hidden state; fallback a = smallest a consistent with w, or 0 with no bar.
Names are re-extraction ranks by (y,x); blocks take 0,1 in block mode. Disputed wall_15_2 disappearing = renaming when the bar appears. Stateless at steps 54/55 there is no bar, so no rename (majority stance).
Open: maze cells {(6,18),(14,38),(38,14)} were inferred from blocked moves; other maze cells and the marker bounds are unobserved.
